description: Is this email address worth sending to? Checks syntax, the domain's mail servers (MX, implicit MX, null MX) and mail provider, disposable domains (10,000+ known), role accounts (info@, sales@), free providers, and misspelled domains (gmial.com suggests gmail.com). Returns valid, risky or invalid with a 0-100 score and reasons. No SMTP probe. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.
name: email_validate
